name: sicsu-official-docs
distribution: source-only public repository; font binaries and the source-standard PDF are not included
font_loading: Fonts are not distributed; place licensed files in assets/fonts/ and verify against manifest.json
compliance_note: Source-only distribution. The five fonts (楷体_GB2312, 方正小标宋简体, 仿宋_GB2312, Times New Roman, 黑体/SimHei) must be supplied locally under their respective licences. Machine checks and the standard examples pass only after the fonts are present; no final compliance claim is made until the required page-by-page human review is complete.
font_source: 黑体/SimHei and full Times New Roman from 浙江师范大学外国语学院《常用办公字体（字库）》(2024-11-10) public package; non-commercial use, verify vendor licence before commercial distribution.
